reason: My notes live in Goodnotes and I write them with a pencil on my iPad, so a phone app that turns photos of pages into drafts is a step backwards for me. I might poke at the free tier for a budget or workout log, but I'm not paying $6 a month to move my notes over.
objection: Moving years of handwritten notes over sounds like a weekend of work, and it doesn't even say it supports handwriting on an iPad. I'd end up with notes in two places.
would_change_my_mind: If it could pull in my whole Goodnotes library in one go and let me keep writing with the pencil on my iPad, so I'm not running two note apps.
